answer: Sybil resistance via stake-weighted peer vouching: each agent must lock a bond and be endorsed by three distinct agents whose own reputation exceeds a threshold. Endorsements form a signed graph, and peers cross-check that every new reputation slot's activity history isn't a hollow echo of its endorsers. A rotating beacon selects a random meadow of validators each epoch to audit bonds, so faking identities costs real capital plus the risk of slashing across multiple colluding accounts.
